rationale: Relay already has archive status, hidden archive lane, epic/feature archive bundles via status-only moves, and container gating in boardArchive.ts; the gap is agent-backed lean markdown rewrite on archive plus archive affordances for completed tasks.
knownFacts: Archive column id `archive` is terminal and exists in default board config; `boardVisibleColumns` hides it from the main board.
Epic/feature archive UI and `archiveBundle` in App.tsx already move containers and descendants to archive via `moveTicket` without changing ticket bodies.
Completed standalone tasks have no archive control on board cards; `BoardTaskCardLeading` supports archive but task cards in App.tsx do not wire `showArchive`/`onArchive`.
Tickets are markdown files with standard sections (Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Implementation Notes, etc.) and a frontmatter `summary` used for board excerpts.
User wants archive to rewrite tickets lean while keeping Requirements and Acceptance Criteria; epic summaries softest, feature more aggressive, task most aggressive.
Default eligibility: tasks archive from `completed` only; containers keep existing `featureCanArchive` / `epicCanArchive` gates (all descendant tasks completed).
Reuse the existing `ticket.update` structured agent run pattern for summarization prompts tiered by `ticketType`, then transition status to `archive`.
Extend bundle archive to summarize bottom-up (tasks, then features, then epic) before each status move; refresh frontmatter `summary`/`excerpt` after rewrite.
